start: HQ, one gym's page, card 'AI Assistant credits'; the gym paid Rs 399 by UPI for a 150 pack

steps.action: Type 150 in 'Credits', pick 'A pack the gym paid for' in 'What it is', write 'paid Rs 399 by UPI on 12 Nov' in 'Note'
user_sees: Help line 'Packs: 50 (₹149), 150 (₹399), 500 (₹999). A minus number takes free credits back.'
must_not: Credits added before the button is tapped
Credits added when the question is cancelled

user_sees: The gym page reloads with 'Saved: <gym name> now has <n> AI credits.'
A new line at the top of the recent credits list
must_not: A balance that did not go up by exactly 150
The add missing from 'What HQ did here' and the HQ log
